energy_derivative_exact module¶

Module containing the exact formula to compute energy derivatives, instead of the Euler approximation

energy_derivative_exact.compute_coefficient_derivatives()¶

Additional convenience coefficients to derive the exact energy

Parameters:
  • r_i (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
  • r_j (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
  • r_k (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
Returns:

  • dalpha_drix (double)
  • dalpha_driy (double)
  • dbeta_drix (double)
  • dbeta_driy (double)
  • dgamma_drix (double)
  • dgamma_driy (double)
energy_derivative_exact.compute_supplementary_vertex_coefficients()¶

Additional convenience coefficients to derive the exact energy

Parameters:
  • r_i (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
  • r_j (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
  • r_k (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
Returns:

  • coeff_lambda (double)
  • coeff_kappa (double)
  • coeff_lambda_prime (double)
  • coeff_kappa_prime (double)

  • coeff_beta_star (double)
  • coeff_gamma_star (double)

energy_derivative_exact.compute_vertex_coefficients()¶

Compute the coefficient described in [Bi et al, 2016] equation A2.

Parameters:
  • r_i (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
  • r_j (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
  • r_k (numpy array) – Coordinates of a Voronoi center that define a vertex with two other centers
Returns:

  • coeff_alpha (double)
  • coeff_beta (double)
  • coeff_gamma (double)
  • coeff_D (double)
